sources.quote: Carefully insert the game car- tridge into the slot at the center of the console.
Hold the game cartridge so the name on the label faces you and reads rIght-sIde-up.

notes: Atari 'Owner's Manual' for the ATARI 5200, rev. 1 (1983, US), archive.org scan, OCR text layer (its OCR misreads some letters, e.g. 'rIght-sIde-up', 'PCWER'); primary.
media: cartridge_top from the manual's two lines (cartridge held upright, label facing the player, into the slot at the centre of the console).

Partial facts not filed: this revision's manual describes TWO numbered controller jacks at the front ('Use jack 1 for one-player games; use jacks 1 and 2 for two-player games'), a channel selector switch at the back left side, a Game Cable, and the power adapter plugging into the TV Switch Box (not the console). The four-port first model is not described by this document. The POWER switch line is OCR-garbled ('PCWER CNfCFF switch at the lower right side'), so controls are not filed. No storage-bay statement read, features.controller_bays null.

dimensions: CHM Revolution page https://www.computerhistory.org/revolution/artifact/185/764 ('Atari 5200 console', Object ID 102618776, 102618764) prints 'Dimensions 4 1/4 x 15 1/4 x 13 1/4 in.' with no axis labels, so it is not filed; the catalog record 102618776 has no dimension line and a whole-pound weight '5 (lb)'.
